commands:
systemd-run --unit=borsuk-header-replay-regressions --wait --pipe -p WorkingDirectory="$root/source" -p CPUQuota=200% -p CPUQuotaPeriodSec=100ms -p AllowedCPUs=0,1 -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p TasksMax=512 -p KillMode=control-group -p TimeoutStopSec=30 -p RuntimeMaxSec="$(( left + 120 ))" --setenv=RUSTUP_HOME="$root/.rustup" --setenv=CARGO_HOME="$root/.cargo" --setenv=PATH="$root/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin" /bin/bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
trap '\''exit 97'\'' TERM HUP INT
root=/mnt/borsuk-header-qualification
ev="$root/evidence/replay-regressions"
cd "$root/source"
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER=
unset BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_COMMAND RUSTFLAGS CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS
cg=$(awk -F: '\''$1==0 {print $3}'\'' /proc/self/cgroup)
printf "%s\n" "$cg" > "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"
for f in cpu.max cpuset.cpus.effective memory.max memory.swap.max pids.max; do cat "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f" > "$ev/$f.before"; done
test "$(cat "$ev/cpu.max.before")" = "200000 100000"
test "$(cat "$ev/cpuset.cpus.effective.before")" = "0-1"
test "$(cat "$ev/memory.max.before")" = 8589934592
test "$(cat "$ev/memory.swap.max.before")" = 0
test "$(cat "$ev/pids.max.before")" = 512
sha256sum --check "$root/source-files.sha256" > "$ev/source-before.log"
left=$(( $(cat "$root/gate-deadline.epoch") - $(date +%s) ))
(( left > 30 )) || exit 124
timeout --kill-after=30 "$left" cargo test --locked -p borsuk --example compare_native_replay -- --list > "$ev/compiled-roster.log" 2>&1
left=$(( $(cat "$root/gate-deadline.epoch") - $(date +%s) ))
(( left > 30 )) || exit 124
printf "%s\n" '\''cargo test --locked -p borsuk --example compare_native_replay -- --test-threads=1'\'' > "$ev/native-command.txt"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$ev/native-started.txt"
set +e
/usr/bin/time -v -o "$ev/native-time.txt" timeout --kill-after=30 "$left" cargo test --locked -p borsuk --example compare_native_replay -- --test-threads=1 > "$ev/native.log" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$status" > "$ev/native-exit.txt"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$ev/native-finished.txt"
sha256sum --check "$root/source-files.sha256" > "$ev/source-after.log"
cmp "$ev/source-before.log" "$ev/source-after.log"
for f in memory.peak memory.events memory.swap.peak pids.peak cpu.stat; do if test -f "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f"; then cat "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f" > "$ev/$f.after"; fi; done
(( status == 0 )) || exit "$status"
grep -E "^[^[:space:]]+: test$" "$ev/compiled-roster.log" | sed "s/: test$//" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$ev/compiled-names.txt"
sed -n "s/^test \(.*\) \.\.\. ok$/\1/p" "$ev/native.log" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$ev/executed-names.txt"
test -s "$ev/compiled-names.txt"
cmp "$ev/compiled-names.txt" "$ev/executed-names.txt"
grep -E "^test result: ok\. [0-9]+ passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;" "$ev/native.log" > "$ev/test-summary.txt"
exit "$status"' > "$ev/systemd-run.log" 2>&1

timeout --kill-after=2 10 systemctl show borsuk-header-replay-regressions.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainCode -p ExecMainStatus -p ControlGroup > "$ev/systemd-after.txt" 2> "$ev/systemd-after.stderr"

if test -s "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"; then cg=$(cat "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"); if [[ "$cg" == "/system.slice/borsuk-header-replay-regressions.service" ]]; then if test ! -d "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg"; then drained=true; elif grep -qx "populated 0" "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/cgroup.events"; then drained=true; fi; fi; fi
native=null; if test -s "$ev/native-exit.txt"; then native=$(cat "$ev/native-exit.txt"); [[ "$native" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || native=null; fi

jq -n --arg schema borsuk-native-header-binding-stage-v1 --arg stage 'replay-regressions' --arg source d077a54f456af30242753ed1e2e397a9416191f7 --argjson manager "$manager" --argjson native "$native" --argjson drained "$drained" '{schema:$schema,stage:$stage,source_commit:$source,manager_exit:$manager,native_exit:$native,owned_cgroup_drained:$drained,performance_claim:false}' > "$ev/terminal.json"
(cd "$ev" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) > "$ev/SHA256SUMS"

for file in "$ev"/*; do remaining=$(( publication_deadline - $(date +%s) - 2 )); (( remaining > 0 )) || exit 124; (( remaining <= 90 )) || remaining=90; timeout --kill-after=2 "$remaining" aws s3api put-object --bucket borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1 --key research/semantic-router/20261010/native-header-binding-qualification-a0001/stages/replay-regressions/"$(basename "$file")" --body "$file" --if-none-match "*" > /dev/null; done
